description: organize/classify.js: two existing organized folders (one with a KNOWLEDGE.md profile, one with recent-summaries fallback) and three unfiled candidates — one a clean match for each existing folder, one that fits neither (should come back folder:null, not a stretch).

knowledgeFiles.billing/invoicing:
## Conventions
- Invoices are generated as immutable PDF snapshots; a correction issues a new invoice, never edits an old one.

## Terminology
- "Dunning" refers to the retry sequence for a failed card charge.

extracted.summary: Rotated the JWT signing key and added a grace-period accepting both old and new keys during rollout.
Added rate limiting to the login endpoint after a credential-stuffing attempt, 5 attempts per IP per minute.
Fixed a bug where an expired refresh token silently logged the user out instead of showing a re-login prompt.
Investigated why a customer's invoice PDF showed the wrong tax rate — the dunning retry had used a stale tax-rate snapshot from the original failed charge.
Discussed whether to migrate the marketing site from Gatsby to Astro, no decision made yet.
